changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetAssetTypeUrlById] ( @AssetTypeID int ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( SELECT CASE T.Object WHEN 'ArtifactType' THEN 'assets/' + CAST(T.uid as nvarchar(max)) WHEN 'ReferenceItem' THEN 'assets/' + + CAST(T.uid as nvarchar(max)) WHEN 'ReferenceItemType' THEN 'assets/' + CAST(T.uid as nvarchar(max)) WHEN 'PolicyType' THEN 'assets/' + CAST(T.uid as nvarchar(max)) WHEN 'ResourceType' THEN 'users/' + CAST(T.uid as nvarchar(max)) WHEN 'RuleType' THEN 'assets/' + CAST(T.uid as nvarchar(max)) WHEN 'TaxonomyType' THEN 'assets/' + CAST(T.uid as nvarchar(max)) end as Url from AssetType T where T.ID = @AssetTypeID )
